boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on downtown Davis and College Park corridors, each with a directly sourced reason to stop.

cards.title: Central Park
cards.subtitle: C Street corridor, downtown Davis
cards.notes: Walk the C Street edge of Central Park and check the Davis Downtown calendar before visiting for scheduled public market activity.
cards.short_summary: A downtown park that hosts the Davis Farmers Market.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Downtown lists Central Park at 301 C St. and schedules Davis Farmers Market events there.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public park; check the event calendar for market dates and times.

cards.title: Davis Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Central Park on the C Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a Saturday morning visit to Central Park and browse the scheduled farmers market vendors at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A recurring Saturday market in Central Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Downtown lists the Davis Farmers Market at Central Park every Saturday from 8 a.m. to 1 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled Saturdays, 8 a.m.–1 p.m.; vendors' goods require purchase.

cards.title: Hattie Weber Museum
cards.subtitle: C Street corridor, at the northeast corner of Central Park
cards.notes: Stop in on a listed opening day to view exhibits on Davis and surrounding-area history; donations are optional.
cards.short_summary: A local-history museum beside Central Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hattie Weber Museum at 445 C Street presents Davis-area history exhibits and states that admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Listed Saturday hours are 10 a.m.–4 p.m.; admission free, donations welcome.

cards.entity_name: United States Bicycling Hall of Fame
cards.title: United States Bicycling Hall of Fame
cards.subtitle: 3rd Street corridor, beside Central Park
cards.notes: Use the posted Wednesday or Saturday hours to see the Hall of Fame at 303 3rd Street and its cycling-focused displays.
cards.short_summary: A cycling-history stop on the 3rd Street edge of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The United States Bicycling Hall of Fame lists its Davis location at 303 3rd Street and public Wednesday and Saturday hours.
cards.source_title: Contact Us | United States Bicycling Hall of Fame
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Wednesday 4–6 p.m. and Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; group visits by appointment.

cards.title: Pence Gallery
cards.subtitle: D Street corridor, downtown Davis
cards.notes: Enter at 212 D Street during gallery hours and spend time with the current exhibitions; the gallery welcomes visitors of all ages.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit art gallery with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Pence Gallery says it is a nonprofit gallery at 212 D Street offering free admission and welcoming visitors of all ages.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, 11:30 a.m.–5 p.m.; free admission.

cards.title: The Artery
cards.subtitle: G Street corridor, downtown Davis
cards.notes: Browse the artist cooperative at 207 G Street, then use the gallery’s posted schedule to time a daytime or Second Friday visit.
cards.short_summary: An artist cooperative gallery on G Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Artery lists its gallery at 207 G Street and identifies itself as an artists cooperative gallery in Davis.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Sunday 11 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Davis Food Co-op
cards.subtitle: G Street corridor, downtown Davis
cards.notes: Use this G Street stop for grocery shopping or prepared-food browsing, and check department closing times before making a specific trip.
cards.short_summary: A downtown cooperative grocery store with daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Food Co-op lists its store at 620 G Street and says it is open daily from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Store listed open daily 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; deli and meat departments close earlier.

cards.title: Davis Varsity Theatre
cards.subtitle: 2nd Street corridor, downtown Davis
cards.notes: Check the current program, then choose a film at the independent theater located at 616 Second Street.
cards.short_summary: An independent movie theater on the 2nd Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Davis Varsity Theatre identifies itself as an independent movie theater and lists its location at 616 Second Street.
cards.access_notes: Check current showtimes and ticket availability before visiting.

cards.title: Davis Amtrak Station
cards.subtitle: 2nd Street corridor, east edge of downtown Davis
cards.notes: Use the station as a rail departure point and arrive early if you need ticketing, baggage, or passenger assistance.
cards.short_summary: A staffed rail station with ticketing and accessibility information.
cards.evidence_claim: Amtrak describes Davis as a staffed station with ticketing kiosks, restrooms, ticket sales, and an accessible platform path.
cards.access_notes: Amtrak advises arriving 30–45 minutes early depending on baggage and assistance needs.

cards.title: International House Davis
cards.subtitle: College Park corridor, beside the campus edge
cards.notes: Look at International House Davis’s program calendar and use its College Park location as a starting point for a cultural event visit.
cards.short_summary: A College Park cultural-programming destination near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: International House Davis lists its address as 10 College Park, Davis, CA 95616 in its public strategic plan.
cards.access_notes: Check the organization’s current calendar and event details before visiting.
